newsitem.title: BOTSWANA: BOTSWANA SEEKS DOUBLE TAX TREATY WITH SINGAPORE.
newsitem.headline: BOTSWANA SEEKS DOUBLE TAX TREATY WITH SINGAPORE.

text.p: Botswana's Commerce and Industry Minister George Kgoroiba will visit Singapore later this year to discuss an agreement on double taxation.

The minister told Singapore's Prime Minister Goh Chok Tong during a visit to the southern African country on Wednesday he would lead a delegation of Botswana businessmen to Singapore before the end of the year.
"I will make sure we can make arrangements or the signing of a double taxation agreement between Singapore and Botswana then," Kgoroiba said.
A group of 35 businessmen from Singapore accompanied Goh to Botswana on an investment promotion visit, which ended on Thursday.
The businessmen were told of investment opportunities in tourism, ostrich farming, tanning and manufacturing.
